# sharqey_group (Resource)

A Sharqey subgroup, created under an existing group/organization root. Renaming/moving is not supported by the server API — changing "parent" or "name" replaces the resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the new subgroup.
- `parent` (String) Full path of the parent group, e.g. "acme-corp" or "acme-corp/infra". Must already exist — this provider never creates an organization root.

### Read-Only

- `full_path` (String) Full path of the created subgroup, e.g. "acme-corp/infra/ci".
- `id` (String) Group UUID, assigned by the server.
